title: ACS message envelope
description: Every inter-agent message travels inside this envelope (R6). Control plane is closed: unknown fields are rejected, never coerced (R4). Natural-language content may only appear inside payload — never in envelope fields (R2).

message_id.description: ULID, unique per message — replay/dedup key.

intent_id.description: Canonical immutable intent this message serves (R3). Mandatory — no message exists without a lineage anchor.

correlation_id.description: Groups all messages of one task run.

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause; null only for run-opening messages.

signature.description: Ed25519 over canonical JSON of envelope-without-signature + payload hash. Null tolerated only in shadow mode.

source_class.description: Classification per docs/enterprise/SOURCE_ONBOARDING_CONTRACT.md — governs payload handling policy.

derived.description: True when payload is a transformation (summary, extraction) of another artefact (R3/IP-7).

source_ref.description: Reference to the original artefact when derived=true.

payload.description: Validated separately against the contract named in envelope.schema.
